secreted_by__insulin.subject: insulin
secreted_by__insulin.source: Insulin is secreted by the beta cells of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans.

deficiency_syndrome__insulin.subject: insulin
deficiency_syndrome__insulin.source: Insulin deficiency (or resistance) causes diabetes mellitus.

secreted_by__cortisol.subject: cortisol
secreted_by__cortisol.source: Cortisol is secreted by the adrenal cortex (zona fasciculata).

deficiency_syndrome__cortisol.subject: cortisol
deficiency_syndrome__cortisol.source: Cortisol deficiency (primary adrenal insufficiency) causes Addison disease.

secreted_by__thyroxine.subject: thyroxine
secreted_by__thyroxine.source: Thyroxine (T4) is secreted by the thyroid gland.

secreted_by__adh.subject: adh
secreted_by__adh.source: Antidiuretic hormone (ADH/vasopressin) is released from the posterior pituitary.

deficiency_syndrome__adh.subject: adh
deficiency_syndrome__adh.source: ADH deficiency causes central diabetes insipidus.

secreted_by__pth.subject: pth
secreted_by__pth.source: Parathyroid hormone is secreted by the parathyroid glands.

secreted_by__growth_hormone.subject: growth_hormone
secreted_by__growth_hormone.source: Growth hormone is secreted by the anterior pituitary (somatotrophs).

deficiency_syndrome__growth_hormone.subject: growth_hormone
deficiency_syndrome__growth_hormone.source: Childhood growth hormone deficiency causes pituitary dwarfism (short stature).
